pull_request.title: Calorimeter: compare tiled ECAL with continuous sector silicon
pull_request.head: codex/ecal10k-untiled-control
pull_request.body:
Follow-up to #134: compare the same 10,000 electron primaries with an isolated, deliberately unbuildable ECAL control having continuous 0.5 mm sensitive silicon across each existing sector carrier face.

Adds an XML-only transform using unchanged native factories, full geometry/material provenance, signed wide Cartesian readout addressing and a paired whole-event bootstrap comparison in ten |eta| and ten signed folded-phi bins. Original sector seams, layer planes, absorber and other passive geometry are retained; support intersections with the new silicon sheets are subtracted explicitly. Added physical silicon is 2,475.64 kg and removed aluminium is 447.43 kg, so this is a coverage/material counterfactual rather than a separable electronics or tiling variance term.

Native validation passes all 2,304 sensitive sheets and unique volume IDs, 3,136 wide-address checks and zero overlaps/extrusions at 1e-5 mm. Ten geometry and three paired-statistics controls pass; the unchanged five angular baseline controls pass. A 24-event/12-worker pilot passes complete saved-event and native-worker audits. Independent PhysVal frozen-source review has no remaining actionable source finding. No engineering/design approval is claimed.

The full 10,000-event control is running with 12 DDSim workers and the original primary bytes/seeds/physics settings. Disk planning requires 53.8 GiB including reserve, versus about 397 GiB available. This draft will receive the completed overlaid curves, mean/distribution controls, paired intervals and compact covariance evidence after full readback.

Raw ROOT, exact primary/event ledgers and bulky logs remain local and ignored. Only source, recipes, figures, compact binwise evidence and curated records are included. Exact task token counters are unavailable.
